title: kbs has no search subcommand; agents keep trying it
description:
Reproduction: kbs search foo -> 'error: unrecognized subcommand search'. Several separate agents on 2026-10-13 tried kbs search first (the obvious name) and had to fall back to kbs list plus grep. Finding a ticket by words in its title, description or comments is the most common lookup before creating a duplicate, and AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING_AGENT tell agents to check for existing tickets first.

Proposal: kbs search <text> [--status ...] [--type ...] over title, description and comments, printing the same table as kbs list. At minimum register search as an alias that prints a pointer to the right command instead of the generic usage error.
Acceptance: kbs search returns matching issues with ids; Gherkin scenario; CLI_REFERENCE.md updated.
right_now_summary: Agents keep trying `kbs search`, then use `kbs list` and grep because search is missing.
